paragraphs.text: Ish Sah , the Vault of Whispers, used to be the dwelling place of Geth on Mirrodin , as well as other Moriok and necromancers .

Ish Sah was a giant chimney , once the stronghold of a long-forgotten human warlord. It was shaped like a cone-like mountain with a circular hole towards the middle and an opening at the top that spew necrogen mist. The top of the huge chimney was shrouded in the ever-present haze of the Mephidross . A viscous purple and green liquid cascaded down one side of the Vault from somewhere within the haze. The rest of the Vault was etched, as if by acid, with a web of interconnecting lines and swirls. The Vault pulsed, much like the chimneys, throughout the etched web-work, giving the feeling that the Vault somehow was alive.
Geth controlled the nim from here, though it also was a place of study for the dark arts and a lodge for Moriok artificers. Those who stayed here were known as Disciples.
After the Mephidross was siphoned of into the Dross Pits , Geth's fortress, possibly the former Ish Sah, was a colossal structure of black bone and red sinew towering above the layer.
